method: Mocked browser protocol using the pinned Supabase Auth JS SDK and coordinator-built out-real static export.
cases: actual SDK PKCE success uses persisted verifier once; session/provider/user data stay memory-only and reload requires sign-in
provider cancellation is generic; callback URL and only the project PKCE slot are cleared
SDK PKCE exchange error is recoverable and does not disclose provider response content
backend 401 clears the in-memory session; no Auth user or error body is shown
API-unavailable retry delayed across logout is discarded; scoped PKCE cleanup preserves unrelated storage
